verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own agent-driven skill-creation mechanisms. /skillify codifies a /scrape intent into a reusable script that runs in ~200ms on later calls. Domain-skills let the agent write per-site skills for itself, which are injected into future sessions and can be promoted from per-project to global. Both are narrow, though: they cover scrape scripts and site notes, not a general meta-skill that guides an agent through authoring, iterating on, and packaging arbitrary new skills. Dev mode only symlinks a checkout for human contributors. Missing for 10: a general-purpose skill-authoring meta-skill, a guided improve/evaluate loop for skills, skill packaging/distribution tooling, and independent corroboration.
